questions.stem: The capital of ARUNACHAL PRADESH is:
questions.explanation: Arunachal Pradesh — Itanagar. Nagaland — Kohima. Manipur — Imphal. Mizoram — Aizawl. (Seven Sisters of NE India have distinctive capitals that banking/SSC papers love.)

questions.stem: Which state has TWO capitals — a summer capital and a winter capital?
questions.explanation: Before the August 2019 reorganisation (which converted J&K into UTs), the erstwhile J&K state had dual capitals: Srinagar (summer) + Jammu (winter) — the Durbar Move tradition since 1872. Maharashtra has Mumbai as capital and Nagpur as 'winter capital' (legislature session), but it is de jure one capital. Uttarakhand made Gairsain its 'summer capital' in 2020 — still de jure one capital (Dehradun). HP's Dharamshala is an 'additional capital' in winter but Shimla remains de jure.

questions.stem: The state of TELANGANA was carved out of Andhra Pradesh on:
questions.explanation: Telangana — 29th state of India, created 2 June 2014 under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014. Hyderabad was the shared capital for up to 10 years; a new capital Amaravati was planned for residual AP. 1 November 2000 is the day Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand, and Jharkhand were formed (that year, one after the other).

questions.stem: Match the STATE with its OFFICIAL LANGUAGE. A. Kerala.  B. Punjab.  C. Odisha.  D. Assam. List-II: 1. Malayalam.  2. Punjabi.  3. Odia.  4. Assamese.
questions.explanation: All four are classical / scheduled languages. Malayalam (Kerala, gained Classical Language status in 2013). Punjabi (Punjab). Odia (Odisha, classical status 2014). Assamese (Assam).

questions.stem: The state with the LARGEST AREA in India is:
questions.explanation: Rajasthan — ~342,239 sq km (largest). MP is second (~308,245 sq km). Maharashtra third. UP has the largest POPULATION but is fourth by area. Goa is smallest by area; Sikkim smallest by population (among states).

questions.stem: The state NAGALAND was formed in the year:
questions.explanation: Nagaland — 16th state of India, formed 1 December 1963 (carved from Assam). Meghalaya and Tripura + Manipur became states in 1972. Mizoram + Arunachal Pradesh in 1987. Sikkim joined the Union in 1975 (22nd state).

questions.stem: Match each NE state with its FAMOUS FESTIVAL. A. Assam.  B. Nagaland.  C. Manipur.  D. Meghalaya. List-II: 1. Bihu.  2. Hornbill Festival.  3. Sangai Festival.  4. Nongkrem Dance Festival.
questions.explanation: Bihu — Assam's signature festival (3 Bihus: Rongali/Kati/Magh). Hornbill — Nagaland 'festival of festivals' (December, since 2000). Sangai — Manipur (November, named after the sangai deer). Nongkrem — Meghalaya (Khasi thanksgiving dance).
